tableLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Gossip Network (Level 1). You hear things. People tell you things. You remember who told you what.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Débora speaks at Thornfield's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
You give Thornfield 1,579 kcal from Haven's bins — real food, honestly counted. June weeps, openly. "The fire network. That's what it's FOR." (Trust +4. They owe you — the ledger remembers.)
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Débora speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.
You give Thornfield 1,358 kcal from Haven's bins — real food, honestly counted. June weeps, openly. "The fire network. That's what it's FOR." (Trust +4. They owe you — the ledger remembers.)
◈ SYSTEM: "One fire was a village. Two fires is a NETWORK. Coordination layer: online — tribute, demands, the long climb, all tracked now. Try not to starve twice as fast."
You accept Emberhold's food — 1,644 kcal on the road, 2 day-parts out. Oscar clasps your runner's shoulder. "That's what the fire network is FOR." (Trust +4.)
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.
🗣️ Nino to Valeria, by the fire: "It waits. We wait. Somebody should check the snares — the table doesn't fill the pantry."
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.
📓 Codex: you've heard of Harvest Table. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Cheyenne — Field 1. Three offers; they took Harvest Table. Earned, chosen. (harvest_table: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Cheyenne chose Harvest Table (harvest_table) at Field 1.
Cheyenne shows you Harvest Table — not the power, just the shape of it. Watch and learn.
📓 Codex: you've SEEN Harvest Table now. Your feasts are rituals. Every feast you host arms the feast surge even without devotion (x1.3 at least), and each guest leaves trusting you a little more.
You accept Emberhold's food — 2,404 kcal on the road, 2 day-parts out. Oscar clasps your runner's shoulder. "That's what the fire network is FOR." (Trust +4.)
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.
💡 KNOWLEDGE COMBINES: Burdock — Level 3. You knew it was safe. the village and a trader knew the rest. Together, it's deeper. Uses: starchy root vegetable. Dig first-year plants (no flower stalk).
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.

🗣️ Diana to Cheyenne, by the fire: "It waits. We wait. Somebody should check the snares — the table doesn't fill the pantry."
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.
You caught the lie in his face and watched the whole table react to it before he'd finished the sentence. Face and room, both open books.
You accept Emberhold's food — 2,902 kcal on the road, 2 day-parts out. Oscar clasps your runner's shoulder. "That's what the fire network is FOR." (Trust +4.)
◈ THE TABLE IS SET. A ring of pale light waits — take your seat from Haven when you are ready. Nothing is final until you sit.

◈ THE TABLE — it is not a table. It's a ring of pale light, and around it, things with too many angles to be faces. Above it all — the audience. Trillions of eyes, and every one of them knows your name. The System speaks, and for once it isn't performing: "HUMANITY PRESENTS ITS CASE."

◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — regional standing, waves 1–3 faced (17/8/6), with 3 wave-4 fought, 9 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 4 · Forage 25 → 24 · capped · Craft 15 · Talk 15 · Explore 30 → 24 · capped)

◈ For a full seat, the ledger still wants: only 0 of 2 different wave-5 monsters faced; standing is regional — the full seat asks for national standing or higher; no capstone deed delivered (military tribute, trade charter, or feast embassy).
The table notes 1 ascension from one village — its terms improve accordingly. Nobody has ever seen that before.

◈ THE BELOVED — The audience is chanting. You don't know the words — it isn't a language with words — but you know the feeling. The table can't move against the cast's favorite. That's leverage. Tonight, the cast is your village.
The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.

The show becomes the government. Strange. It works. Trillions of viewers hold the table to account in real time, and humanity's seat is wherever the cameras are. You made popularity into a constitution — and constitutions, unlike ratings, don't dip.
The terms held — the table had priced the village, ascension and all, and the village paid in full.
